nodes.label: Windows XP Bliss Desktop Wallpaper
nodes.description: Photographic desktop wallpaper depicting a vivid green rolling grass hill under a bright blue sky with scattered white cumulus clouds. Closely matches the iconic Windows XP 'Bliss' default wallpaper.

nodes.label: Green Rolling Hill Foreground Element
nodes.description: Lush, saturated green grass hill occupying the lower half of the image, curving gently from lower-left to upper-center. Small yellow wildflowers are faintly visible near the bottom edge.

nodes.label: Blue Sky with White Cumulus Clouds
nodes.description: Vivid cerulean blue sky filling the upper portion of the image, populated with multiple white and light-grey cumulus and cirrus clouds of varying sizes.

nodes.label: Distant Hills on Horizon
nodes.description: Low-lying hills and possibly tree-line visible in the far background on the right side of the horizon, providing depth and landscape context.

nodes.label: Windows XP Bliss Nostalgia Reference
nodes.description: The deliberate use of the Windows XP Bliss wallpaper (or a very close replica) reinforces the Win95/WinXP-era nostalgic aesthetic of the GooseOS desktop environment, signaling retro computing theming to users familiar with early-2000s personal computing.

nodes.label: Retro Desktop OS Aesthetic Design Decision
nodes.description: Choosing a wallpaper nearly identical to Windows XP Bliss is an intentional UI/UX pattern establishing GooseOS as a nostalgic parody or homage to classic Windows desktop environments, expected to evoke immediate recognition in users who grew up with Windows XP.

nodes.label: High Saturation Color Palette
nodes.description: The image uses highly saturated greens and blues, giving it an almost hyper-real photographic quality. Dominant colors: vivid green (#4caf50 range), bright sky blue (#2196f3 range), and pure white clouds.

nodes.label: Photographic Background Texture
nodes.description: The background is a photographic image (not illustrated or generated), providing a realistic textured backdrop contrasting with the flat/pixelated Win95-style UI chrome elements layered on top.

nodes.label: Background Layer for Desktop UI Composition
nodes.description: As a named 'backgrounds' asset, this image is intended to sit behind all other UI elements (windows, taskbar, icons), providing the full-screen desktop canvas typical of a windowed OS environment.
